answer: The wheelwright yard smells of fresh oak, and cart wheels lean in a row against the wall. lotus cuts the spokes to length and tapers each one with the drawknife. Steel handle oilpresser wickroom brand — a brand handle oilpressers cut twice wickroom brass tallies hold. cipher fits the iron tyre round the rim and shrinks it tight with the fire. zenith checks the dish of the wheel and spins it true on the axle. A man faking this proof must build 23 wheels without one tyre slipping loose, and the next still wobbles where the spoke ran short.
